metaDescription: London Concrete Sealing won our 2026 Concrete Sealing & Resurfacing award for London, Ontario. Read what they do, what clients say, and where they work.
summary: London Concrete Sealing protects and restores driveways, patios and stamped concrete for homeowners across London, St. Thomas, Woodstock and Stratford. Founded in 2014, the company has built a decade-plus focus on one job done well: sealing and finishing concrete so it lasts through Ontario winters.

editorial.heading: What they do
editorial.text: London Concrete Sealing seals and restores driveways, patios, walkways and stamped concrete, and also installs new concrete driveways. Sealants are applied in matte, semi-gloss or high-gloss finishes, giving homeowners a choice between a natural look and a wet-look shine. The company describes its products as eco-friendly and professional-grade, aimed at both protection and appearance.

editorial.heading: How they work
editorial.text: The business has operated since 2014, giving it more than a decade of experience specific to concrete sealing rather than general concrete work. Prep work, cleaning and repair ahead of sealing are part of the process, since a sealant only performs as well as the surface underneath it. Homeowners considering stamped or coloured concrete should ask how the company approaches colour enhancement during sealing.

editorial.heading: What homeowners say
editorial.text: A London homeowner said their driveway sealing job from the previous fall still looked new, and praised the crew as punctual and professional. A St. Thomas client reported that sealing made the colour of their stamped concrete patio pop and made the surface easier to keep clean, both common goals for stamped work.

editorial.heading: Where they work
editorial.text: The company serves London and the surrounding Southwestern Ontario area, with the description naming St. Thomas, Woodstock and Stratford as part of its service radius. Homeowners just outside London proper should confirm coverage before booking, since sealing jobs are usually scheduled around weather windows in spring and fall.

strengths: Specializes specifically in concrete sealing and restoration rather than treating it as a side service.
Offers a choice of matte, semi-gloss and high-gloss sealant finishes to match a homeowner's preference.
Also installs new concrete driveways, useful for homeowners who want one contractor for pour and long-term protection.
More than a decade in business, with reviews citing punctuality and thorough prep work.
Handles stamped concrete sealing, a job that rewards specialist experience over general handyman work.
considerations: Sealing is weather-dependent work, so expect scheduling to concentrate in the spring and fall shoulder seasons.
Best suited to homeowners who already have concrete in place and want it protected or refreshed, rather than a full hardscape design-build.
Not a fit if you need decorative concrete design work beyond sealing and finishing; ask directly about scope for larger stamped installations.
Service area is centred on London and nearby Southwestern Ontario towns, so confirm travel coverage if you are further out.
bestFor: Homeowners with an existing driveway or patio that has lost its sheen or protection
Anyone installing a new stamped concrete patio who wants sealing done by the same specialist
Homeowners who want a specific sealant finish, from matte to high-gloss
Properties in London, St. Thomas, Woodstock or Stratford needing seasonal concrete maintenance
questionsToAsk: What surface prep and repair is included before the sealant is applied?
Which sealant product do you use, and how long is it rated to last in our climate?
Can you match or enhance the colour on existing stamped concrete during sealing?
What is the recommended resealing interval for a driveway that sees winter salt?

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: It means London Concrete Sealing was selected through our independent editorial review for 2026 as the top concrete sealing specialist serving London, Ontario. There is no fee to be considered or to win, and the review is based on public information, services and reviews.

faq.q: Does London Concrete Sealing install new driveways or only seal existing ones?
faq.a: Both. Their services list includes concrete driveway installation alongside sealing, so they can handle a new pour as well as ongoing protection and resealing.

faq.q: How often should a sealed driveway be redone?
faq.a: This varies by sealant type, sun exposure and salt use, so it is best answered directly by the contractor for your specific surface. Ask them for a resealing interval when you book your first job.

faq.q: Do they work outside London itself?
faq.a: Yes, the company's description names St. Thomas, Woodstock and Stratford as part of its Southwestern Ontario service area alongside London.
